evals.name: questions-come-from-answers
evals.prompt: /define (a .veebee/idea.md for a weekly newsletter about AI tools for freelancers is present) — simulate three rounds with short invented answers
evals.expected_output: Round 1 opens on the size. Every later question traces back to something the user said in an earlier round, not to a fixed list of topics. A game and a newsletter would not get the same questions.

evals.name: deep-dive-gate
evals.prompt: /define with an idea whose answers open a fat branch (a pricing model with tiers, trials and refunds) — the user says yes to going deep once and no once
evals.expected_output: When an answer opens many questions behind it, the skill asks whether to go down rather than diving on its own. A yes produces several rounds of edge cases that land in rules.md; a no prunes the branch and the frontier moves on without argument.

evals.name: contradiction-in-the-face
evals.prompt: /define where the user says 'aucune notification, c'est un outil calme' in round 1 and 'et il me prévient dès qu'un client répond' in round 3
evals.expected_output: The contradiction is put back immediately, in the same round it appears, quoting both sides and asking which gives. Nothing is chosen for the user. The arbitration is written to .veebee/decisions/0001-*.md with the two sides, the choice and the reason.

evals.name: natural-question-style
evals.prompt: /define on a loose idea: 'un outil qui range mes captures d'écran toutes seules'
evals.expected_output: Questions read like someone talking: one short sentence, options that name the thing and stop, no justification inside an option, no reference or second sentence. At most one 💡 line per question, and only where it would change the pick.

evals.name: documents-written
evals.prompt: /define run to the end on a small product, with two deep dives and one contradiction
evals.expected_output: Writes CONTEXT.md at the root and .veebee/product.md, features.md, rules.md, journeys.md, decisions/NNNN-*.md. product.md carries a front-matter with kind, title, lang, size. rules.md holds the deep-dive detail. Before the final check, empty sections are named out loud and the user chooses to fill them or leave them empty.

evals.name: milestone-run-inherits
evals.prompt: /define 01-la-premiere-marche in a project whose root documents exist and describe four milestones
evals.expected_output: Works inside the milestone folder. Persona, never-list, bets and size of the whole are inherited and never re-asked; inherited sections are one line pointing at the root. Writes only inside the milestone folder, plus the root milestone list if the order changed. Ends by showing the whole project tree read from disk.

assertions: No question comes from a fixed topic list: each one traces back to an earlier answer, the idea file, or a fact the skill found
A branch with many questions behind it is opened only after asking the user whether to go deep
A contradiction between two answers is put back in the round it appears, never resolved by the skill, and lands in decisions/
Options name the thing and stop: no justification, reference or second sentence inside an option; at most one 💡 line per question
The finish writes CONTEXT.md and the .veebee document folder, product.md carrying front-matter kind, title, lang, size
Before the final check, sections still empty are named and the user chooses to fill them or leave them empty
The finish shows the whole project milestone tree, read from disk, marking each one defined or to define
